states.name: hh
states.meaning: Hours BCD counter, 01-12 (output hh), reset to 12 (0x12).

rules.spec_quote: Reset is the active high synchronous signal that resets the clock to "12:00 AM."

rules.condition: reset==0: if ena==1 then apply one BCD second increment with carries: ss=ss+1 BCD; if ss was 0x59 then ss=0x00 and mm=mm+1 BCD; if ss was 0x59 and mm was 0x59 then mm=0x00 and hh=hh+1 BCD; hour wraps 12->01 after 12:59:59; pm toggles only on 11:59:59->12:00:00 (AM/PM changes), and pm is otherwise unchanged; if ena==0 then hold all outputs
rules.spec_quote: a pulse on ena whenever your clock should increment

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: first posedge clk with reset==0; synchronous release takes effect at that sampled edge

mid: Optional mid changes occur after sampling and before the other edge; they are carried to the start of the next row and do not alter already-sampled outputs.

uncertain.note: Enable edge and BCD ranges are specified, but the exact 12-hour wrap and PM-toggle point are inferred from '12-hour clock (with am/pm indicator)' rather than explicitly stated.
candidates: Standard 12-hour clock convention: PM toggles at the 11:59:59<->12:00:00 boundary and hours wrap 12->01 after 12:59:59.
PM could toggle at the 12:59:59->01:00:00 boundary instead of at 12:00:00 under an unusual convention.
Hour rollover could be 12->01 immediately at 12:00:00 rather than after 12:59:59 under an unusual convention.
